answer: The cross-epoch consistency gate requires every identity to match its own recorded behavior profile across at least three epochs, which is the enforcement rule. An identity that diverges is blocked from new work until it submits a ferrous seal tied to its prior actions, though the term ferrous seal remains unclear. Each blocked sybil must therefore maintain a separate jade credential and a stable pulse of non-timing actions, paying the full setup and maintenance cost per identity rather than once. This includes jade, pulse, and cost.
